name: Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack
author: Quaternius

exclude..*_Dead_.*: Kid-safe: bare dead trees read as spooky (Spooky Hollow has its own)
exclude..*_Snow.*: Winter pieces: kept for a snow world
exclude.Cactus.*|PalmTree_.*: Not a woodland plant (desert and beach): kept for a later world
exclude.Corn_.*|Wheat: Farm crops: kept for a farm world

source: branch asset-packs, folder quaternius-ultimate-nature/ (uploaded by the owner, November 2026)
notes: Nothing in this pack is a weapon or scary; Cactus_1 has spines and is left out with the other cacti.
The pack has no pictures: each material is one plain colour, which FBX2glTF reads too dark, so defaults.colours gives every material its colour (Wild Woods' woodland palette).
Trees are 40 to 110 KB each (the Kenney ones 4 to 17 KB), so Wild Woods 1.0.0 takes five trees and 12 smaller pieces.
